How I Work

My Process

A clear, structured process means no surprises, just results delivered on time and on brief.

01

Discovery

We talk about your goals, audience, and vision. I ask the right questions so I understand exactly what you need before touching a line of code.

02

Design

I map out the layout, color system, and UI before building. You see the direction early so we're aligned from day one.

03

Build

Clean, fast, responsive code. I build mobile-first and test across devices as I go, so nothing breaks at launch.

04

Launch

I handle deployment, final checks, and hand everything over clearly. You walk away with a site that works, and the knowledge to manage it.
